stock.finding: StockDisponible is a stored generated column; a NULL-safe unique physical stock key and same-warehouse composite FK already protect canonical stock persistence.

order.finding: Order persistence already enforces state checks, atomic idempotency key+fingerprint, SHA-256 fingerprint shape, unique quote and unique idempotency key.

reservation.finding: Reservation persistence already enforces unique order linkage and durable lifecycle indexes/relations.

payment.finding: Payment persistence is tenant-bound, constrains amount/currency/state and has unique tenant+provider reference/event/idempotency indexes.

migration_decision: N7.9.B introduced no new domain property or aggregate and therefore creates no legitimate EF model delta.
Adding a migration now would be speculative and would duplicate or perturb already-certified stock/order/reservation/payment persistence.
Any later API-stage need for a genuinely new durable coordinate must be justified by that material implementation and then handled by a focused persistence change; none exists at this parent.
